"""Qualify observable prefixes of the actual transformer source on CPU and Metal."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']='1'
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'fair'))
import protocol as p
import transformer_reference as r

def references(m,d):
    arrays=r.inputs(m,d,1);x,wq,wk,wv,wo,up,down=arrays
    eps=r.np.float32(.00001);scale=r.np.float32(1/r.math.sqrt(d))
    nominal={};nominal['norm']=r.rms32(x,eps)
    for name,w in zip(('q','k','v'),(wq,wk,wv)):nominal[name]=r.strict_matmul(nominal['norm'],w)
    nominal['probabilities']=r.softmax32(r.strict_matmul(nominal['q'],nominal['k'].T)*scale)
    nominal['residual']=x+r.strict_matmul(r.strict_matmul(nominal['probabilities'],nominal['v']),wo)
    nominal['feed']=r.rms32(nominal['residual'],eps)
    nominal['hidden']=r.np.maximum(r.strict_matmul(nominal['feed'],up),r.np.float32(0))
    values=[(v.astype(r.np.float64),r.np.zeros(v.shape,r.np.float64)) for v in arrays]
    x,wq,wk,wv,wo,up,down=values
    high={'norm':r.rms(*x,float(eps))}
    for name,w in zip(('q','k','v'),(wq,wk,wv)):high[name]=r.mm(high['norm'],w)
    score,error=r.mm(high['q'],(high['k'][0].T,high['k'][1].T))
    error=error*float(scale)+r.gamma(2)*r.np.abs(score*float(scale));score*=float(scale)
    high['probabilities']=r.softmax(score,error)
    high['residual']=r.add(x,r.mm(r.mm(high['probabilities'],high['v']),wo))
    high['feed']=r.rms(*high['residual'],float(eps))
    h,e=r.mm(high['feed'],up);high['hidden']=(r.np.maximum(h,0),e)
    return nominal,high

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--build-dir',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--full-build',dest='full_bundle',type=Path,required=True,help='Frozen full-block build directory supplying its authored main/capture layout')
    args=parser.parse_args();assert not args.output.exists()
    root=p.ROOT;fair=Path(__file__).parent/'fair';source=Path(__file__).parent/'TransformerBlock.k';build=args.build_dir.resolve();build.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    compiler=root/'build/native/native/kalandra';native=compiler.parent/'libkalandra-native-runtime.a';metal=compiler.parent/'metal/libkalandra-metal-optimized.a';task=compiler.parent/'libkalandra-task-core-optimized.a'
    full=(args.full_bundle/'block-gpu.k').read_text();gpu_main='fn main()'+full.split('fn main()',1)[1]
    signature=source.read_text().split('fn main()')[0];header=next(line for line in signature.splitlines() if line.startswith('fn block('))
    assignments=[line for line in signature.splitlines() if line.startswith('  ') and '=' in line]
    assert len(assignments)==7
    assignments+=['  hidden=relu(matmul(feed,up))']
    sources=[Path(__file__),source,fair/'TransformerCpu.cpp',fair/'TransformerGpu.cpp',fair/'TransformerBlock.h',fair/'ResidualFfn.h',fair/'transformer_reference.py',fair/'ffn_reference.py']
    initial={str(f):p.sha(f) for f in sources+[compiler,native,metal,task]};artifacts=[];records=[]
    for index,line in enumerate(assignments):
        stage=line.strip().split('=',1)[0];directory=build/stage;directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        body=header+'\n'+'\n'.join(assignments[:index+1])+'\n  '+stage+'\n'
        cpu_source=directory/'cpu.k';cpu_source.write_text(body+'fn main()->int64:\n  0\n')
        ir=directory/'cpu.ll';p.run([compiler,cpu_source,'--test-entry','block','--arithmetic','hardware','-O2','--emit-llvm',ir,'-o',directory/'standalone'])
        gpu_source=directory/'gpu.k';gpu_source.write_text(body+gpu_main);bundle=directory/'bundle'
        p.run([compiler,gpu_source,'--target','metal','--arithmetic','hardware','-O2','-o',bundle])
        host=(bundle/'host.cpp').read_text();loads=re.findall(r'auto (kernel\d+)=(r\.load[^;]+);if\(!kernel\d+\)\{[^\n]+',host)
        start=host.index('auto operands0=');end=host.index('=r.numericProgram',start);code=host[start:host.rfind('\nf.',start,end)]
        slots=list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'f\.v\d+','\n'.join(s for s in code.splitlines() if s.startswith('auto scalars')))));assert 1<=len(slots)<=2
        for old,new in zip(slots,('epsilon','scale')):code=code.replace(old,new)
        result=re.search(r'\.numericProgram\(task,f\.v\d+,std::array<m::Buffer,7>\{[^\n]*?\},code,(\d+)u,kalandra::NumericType::Float32,false\)',host);assert result
        text=f'struct Program {{std::array<m::Kernel,{len(loads)}> kernels;\nProgram(m::Runtime&r,std::string directory){{auto target=r.device();ffn::check(bool(target));\n'
        for name,call in loads:text+=f'auto {name}='+call.replace('f.directory','directory')+f';ffn::check(bool({name}));\n'
        text+='kernels={'+','.join('*'+name for name,_ in loads)+'};}\nTaskHandle launch(m::Runtime&r,TaskCore&core,GroupHandle group,const std::array<m::Buffer,7>&inputs,float epsilon,float scale){\n'
        for i in range(len(loads)):text+=f'auto*kernel{i}=&kernels[{i}];\n'
        text+=code+f'\nreturn r.numericProgram(core,group,inputs,code,{result[1]}u,kalandra::NumericType::Float32,false);\n'+'}\n};\n'
        generated=directory/'TransformerProgram.h';generated.write_text(text)
        cols='m' if stage=='probabilities' else '4*d' if stage=='hidden' else 'd'
        cpu=(fair/'TransformerCpu.cpp').read_text().replace('../../runtime/Tensor.h',str(root/'native/runtime/Tensor.h'))
        cpu=cpu.replace('out.sizes==data.shapes[0]',f'(out.sizes[0]==m && out.sizes[1]==({cols}))').replace('cells(m*d)',f'cells(m*({cols}))').replace('c<d;','c<('+cols+');').replace('cells[r*d+c]',f'cells[r*({cols})+c]')
        gpu=(fair/'TransformerGpu.cpp').read_text().replace('../../metal/Metal.h',str(root/'native/metal/Metal.h'))
        gpu_cols='rows' if stage=='probabilities' else '4*d' if stage=='hidden' else 'd'
        gpu=gpu.replace('out.shape()[1]==d && out.bytes()==rows*d*4ull',f'out.shape()[1]==({gpu_cols}) && out.bytes()==rows*({gpu_cols})*4ull').replace('cells(rows*d)',f'cells(rows*({gpu_cols}))')
        cpp=directory/'Cpu.cpp';cpp.write_text(cpu);gpu_cpp=directory/'Gpu.cpp';gpu_cpp.write_text(gpu)
        flags=['-std=c++23','-O2','-pthread','-ffp-contract=off','-Wno-override-module','-I'+str(fair.resolve()),'-I'+str(directory)]
        p.run([p.CLANG,*flags,cpp,ir,native,'-o',directory/'cpu'])
        p.run([p.CLANG,*flags,gpu_cpp,metal,task,'-framework','Foundation','-framework','Metal','-o',directory/'gpu'])
        for m,d in ((3,7),(16,64)):
            nominal,high=references(m,d);want,bound=high[stage];bound=2*bound+r.np.finfo(r.np.float32).tiny
            for backend in ('cpu','gpu'):
                command=[directory/backend,*([bundle] if backend=='gpu' else []),m,d,1,1,0,1,1]
                row=json.loads(p.run(command));actual=r.np.asarray(row['cells'],r.np.float32).reshape(want.shape)
                error=r.np.abs(actual.astype(r.np.float64)-want);assert r.np.all(error<=bound),(stage,backend,float(r.np.max(error/bound)))
                exact=int(r.np.sum(actual.view(r.np.uint32)==nominal[stage].view(r.np.uint32)))
                if stage in ('norm','q','k','v'):assert exact==actual.size,(stage,backend,exact,actual.size)
                records.append(dict(stage=stage,backend=backend,m=m,d=d,cells=int(actual.size),nominal_matching_cells=exact,max_abs_error=float(r.np.max(error)),max_error_bound_ratio=float(r.np.max(error/bound))))
        artifacts +=[cpu_source,gpu_source,cpp,gpu_cpp,generated,ir,directory/'cpu',directory/'gpu',bundle/'host.cpp',*bundle.glob('*.metallib')]
        print(stage+': complete CPU/GPU intermediate matrices verified for odd and tiled shapes',flush=True)
    assert all(p.sha(f)==h for f,h in initial.items())
    p.evidence(args.output,dict(contract=__doc__,records=records,source_snapshots={p.key(f):f.read_text() for f in sources}),sources,artifacts+[compiler,native,metal,task],compiler)
if __name__=='__main__':main()

# Bias-free single-head unmasked pre-RMSNorm encoder block, unit RMS gain.
# This is a complete block, not a tokenizer, KV cache, or generation engine.
fn block(x:Tensor[float32,?,?],wq:Tensor[float32,?,?],wk:Tensor[float32,?,?],wv:Tensor[float32,?,?],wo:Tensor[float32,?,?],up:Tensor[float32,?,?],down:Tensor[float32,?,?],epsilon:float32,scale:float32)->Tensor[float32,?,?]:
  norm=rmsNormRows(x,epsilon)
  q=matmul(norm,wq)
  k=matmul(norm,wk)
  v=matmul(norm,wv)
  probabilities=softmaxRows(matmul(q,transpose(k))*scale)
  residual=x+matmul(matmul(probabilities,v),wo)
  feed=rmsNormRows(residual,epsilon)
  residual+matmul(relu(matmul(feed,up)),down)

"""Independent full-block oracle and propagated float32 forward error bounds.

The nominal reference uses separately rounded products and an adjacent-pair
tree, without BLAS. The float64 mathematical reference and per-cell bounds
permit float32 library FMA/reassociation and documented exp error, then propagate
each stage's error through normalization, softmax, ReLU, and residuals.
"""
import functools
import math
import numpy as np
from ffn_reference import tree,strict_matmul
U=2.0**-24
def gamma(n):return n*U/(1-n*U)
def inputs(m,d,pattern):
    arrays=[]
    for stream,shape in enumerate([(m,d)]+[(d,d)]*4+[(d,4*d),(4*d,d)]):
        z=np.arange(math.prod(shape),dtype=np.uint32)+np.uint32((0x9e3779b9*(stream+1))&0xffffffff)
        z=(z^(z>>16))*np.uint32(0x85ebca6b);z=(z^(z>>13))*np.uint32(0xc2b2ae35);z^=z>>16
        denominator=(127 if stream else 29) if pattern else (128 if stream else 32)
        arrays.append(((z%17).astype(np.int32)-8).astype(np.float32).reshape(shape)/np.float32(denominator))
    return arrays
def rms32(x,epsilon):
    denominator=np.sqrt((tree(x*x,axis=1)/np.float32(x.shape[1]))+epsilon)
    return x/denominator[:,None]
def softmax32(x):
    shifted=x-np.max(x,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    exponent=np.exp(shifted.astype(np.float64)).astype(np.float32)
    return exponent/tree(exponent,axis=1)[:,None]
def rms(value,error,epsilon):
    n=value.shape[1];squares=value*value
    mean=np.mean(squares,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    propagated=np.mean((2*np.abs(value)+error)*error,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    total_error=propagated+gamma(2*n+4)*(mean+propagated+epsilon)
    denominator=np.sqrt(mean+epsilon)
    lower=np.sqrt(np.maximum(epsilon,mean+epsilon-total_error))
    upper=np.sqrt(mean+epsilon+total_error)
    low=np.minimum((value-error)/lower,(value-error)/upper)
    high=np.maximum((value+error)/lower,(value+error)/upper)
    result=value/denominator
    bound=np.maximum(np.abs(result-low),np.abs(high-result))+gamma(4)*np.abs(result)
    return result,bound
def softmax(value,error):
    maximum=np.max(value,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    exponent=np.exp(value-maximum);result=exponent/np.sum(exponent,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    # Outward input/max/subtraction intervals, plus four-ULP exp uncertainty.
    rounding=gamma(3)*(np.abs(value)+np.abs(maximum))
    low=np.exp(value-error-np.max(value+error,axis=1,keepdims=True)-rounding)*(1-8*U)
    high=np.exp(value+error-np.max(value-error,axis=1,keepdims=True)+rounding)*(1+8*U)
    n=value.shape[1]
    lower=low/(np.sum(high,axis=1,keepdims=True)*(1+gamma(2*n+3)))
    upper=high/(np.sum(low,axis=1,keepdims=True)*(1-gamma(2*n+3)))
    return result,np.maximum(np.abs(result-lower),np.abs(upper-result))
def mm(a,b):
    x,ex=a;y,ey=b
    magnitude=np.abs(x)@np.abs(y)
    propagated=np.abs(x)@ey+ex@np.abs(y)+ex@ey
    return x@y,propagated+gamma(2*x.shape[1]+4)*(magnitude+propagated)
def add(a,b):
    x,ex=a;y,ey=b;result=x+y
    return result,ex+ey+gamma(2)*(np.abs(x)+np.abs(y)+ex+ey)
@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def oracle(m,d,pattern):
    x,wq,wk,wv,wo,up,down=inputs(m,d,pattern)
    epsilon=np.float32(.00001);scale=np.float32(1/math.sqrt(d))
    n=rms32(x,epsilon);q=strict_matmul(n,wq);k=strict_matmul(n,wk);v=strict_matmul(n,wv)
    p=softmax32(strict_matmul(q,k.T)*scale)
    residual=x+strict_matmul(strict_matmul(p,v),wo)
    hidden=np.maximum(strict_matmul(rms32(residual,epsilon),up),np.float32(0))
    nominal=residual+strict_matmul(hidden,down)
    arrays=[(a.astype(np.float64),np.zeros(a.shape,np.float64)) for a in (x,wq,wk,wv,wo,up,down)]
    x,wq,wk,wv,wo,up,down=arrays
    n=rms(*x,float(epsilon));q=mm(n,wq);k=mm(n,wk);v=mm(n,wv)
    score,error=mm(q,(k[0].T,k[1].T));error=error*abs(float(scale))+gamma(2)*np.abs(score*float(scale));score*=float(scale)
    probability=softmax(score,error)
    residual=add(x,mm(mm(probability,v),wo))
    hidden,error=mm(rms(*residual,float(epsilon)),up);hidden=np.maximum(hidden,0)
    high,bound=add(residual,mm((hidden,error),down))
    # Also cover the float64 oracle's much smaller arithmetic error.
    return nominal,high,2*bound+np.finfo(np.float32).tiny
def assess(m,d,pattern,row):
    nominal,high,bound=oracle(m,d,pattern)
    actual=np.asarray(row['cells'],np.float32).reshape(m,d)
    assert np.isfinite(actual).all()
    error=np.abs(actual.astype(np.float64)-high)
    assert np.all(error<=bound),(m,d,pattern,float(np.max(error/bound)))
    assert float(tree(actual.ravel()))==row['result'],(row['result'],float(tree(actual.ravel())))
    return dict(cells=m*d,max_abs_error=float(np.max(error)),max_forward_bound=float(np.max(bound)),
                max_error_bound_ratio=float(np.max(error/bound)),nominal_matching_cells=int(np.sum(actual.view(np.uint32)==nominal.view(np.uint32))),
                max_difference_nominal=float(np.max(np.abs(actual.astype(np.float64)-nominal.astype(np.float64))))),actual

"""Independent float32 operation/tree oracle and float64 forward-error checks.

No BLAS is used for the strict oracle. Every product and adjacent pair is
rounded separately; complete output matrices are checked, including timed sizes.
"""
import functools
import numpy as np

def inputs(m,d,pattern):
    def make(shape,stream):
        z=np.arange(np.prod(shape),dtype=np.uint32)+np.uint32((0x9e3779b9*(stream+1))&0xffffffff)
        z=(z^(z>>16))*np.uint32(0x85ebca6b)
        z=(z^(z>>13))*np.uint32(0xc2b2ae35)
        z=z^(z>>16)
        denominator=(127 if stream else 29) if pattern else (128 if stream else 32)
        return ((z%17).astype(np.int32)-8).astype(np.float32).reshape(shape)/np.float32(denominator)
    return make((m,d),0),make((d,4*d),1),make((4*d,d),2)

def tree(values,axis=-1):
    values=np.moveaxis(np.asarray(values,dtype=np.float32),axis,-1).copy()
    while values.shape[-1]>1:
        n=values.shape[-1]
        paired=values[...,:n-1:2]+values[...,1:n:2]
        values=np.concatenate((paired,values[...,-1:]),axis=-1) if n&1 else paired
    return values[...,0]

def strict_matmul(a,b):
    out=np.empty((a.shape[0],b.shape[1]),np.float32)
    for row in range(0,a.shape[0],4):
        for col in range(0,b.shape[1],16):
            terms=a[row:row+4,:,None]*b[None,:,col:col+16]
            out[row:row+4,col:col+16]=tree(terms,axis=1)
    return out

@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def oracle(m,d,pattern):
    x,up,down=inputs(m,d,pattern)
    hidden=np.maximum(strict_matmul(x,up),np.float32(0))
    cells=strict_matmul(hidden,down)+x
    scalar=float(tree(cells.reshape(-1)))
    # BLAS may use FMA/reassociation. Standard gamma bounds propagate the first
    # GEMM error through 1-Lipschitz ReLU and the second GEMM/residual addition.
    # float64 oracle's own smaller error is covered by doubling these bounds.
    a,b,c=(v.astype(np.float64) for v in (x,up,down))
    high_hidden=np.maximum(a@b,0)
    high=high_hidden@c+a
    u=2.0**-24
    gamma=lambda k:k*u/(1-k*u)
    e1=gamma(2*d)*(np.abs(a)@np.abs(b))
    bound=2*(e1@np.abs(c)+gamma(8*d+2)*((np.abs(high_hidden)+e1)@np.abs(c)+np.abs(a)))
    return cells,scalar,high,bound

def assess(m,d,pattern,row,strict):
    want,scalar,high,bound=oracle(m,d,pattern)
    actual=np.asarray(row['cells'],np.float32).reshape(m,d)
    assert np.isfinite(actual).all() and np.isfinite(row['result'])
    error=np.abs(actual.astype(np.float64)-high)
    assert np.all(error<=bound), (m,d,pattern,float(np.max(error-bound)))
    same=bool(np.array_equal(actual.view(np.uint32),want.view(np.uint32)))
    if strict:
        assert same, (m,d,pattern,'strict cell bits disagree',np.argwhere(actual.view(np.uint32)!=want.view(np.uint32))[:4].tolist())
        assert np.float32(row['result']).view(np.uint32)==np.float32(scalar).view(np.uint32)
    # The scalar is also validated against this backend's complete output cells.
    assert np.float32(row['result']).view(np.uint32)==tree(actual.reshape(-1)).view(np.uint32)
    return dict(cells=m*d,strict_bit_match=same,max_absolute_error=float(error.max()),
                max_error_bound=float(bound.max()),max_bound_fraction=float(np.max(error/np.maximum(bound,1e-300))),
                expected=row['result'])

def self_test():
    # Independently check vectorized product/tree semantics using scalar Python
    # binary64 (exact for each float32 product/pair), rounded at every operation.
    x,up,_=inputs(3,7,1)
    def scalar_sum(v):
        v=[np.float32(z) for z in v]
        while len(v)>1:
            v=[np.float32(float(v[i])+float(v[i+1])) for i in range(0,len(v)-1,2)]+(v[-1:] if len(v)&1 else [])
        return v[0]
    a=strict_matmul(x,up)
    for r in range(3):
        for col in range(28):
            expected=scalar_sum([np.float32(float(x[r,k])*float(up[k,col])) for k in range(7)])
            assert a[r,col].view(np.uint32)==expected.view(np.uint32)
    cells,scalar,_,_=oracle(3,7,1)
    row=dict(cells=cells.reshape(-1).tolist(),result=scalar)
    assess(3,7,1,row,True)
    row['cells'][0]+=1
    try:assess(3,7,1,row,True)
    except AssertionError:return dict(scalar_product_cells=84,corruption_rejected=True)
    raise AssertionError('corrupted cell accepted')
